commonClauses.requirement: The production ELF supplies the exact entry, execution, exit, ownership, and call boundary.
The entry binds each semantic value to a register or represented memory window.
The entry supplies configured-machine, PMA, MMIO, read-access, and write-access facts used by the first instruction.
Each observed exit agrees with the declared result and control-flow boundary.
The contract states a termination bound and exact register, memory, code, and auxiliary-state frames.

host-write.semanticOperation: Append the represented source bytes to the bare-metal output context.

extraClauses.requirement: The host write equals the entry pointer and length byte window.

allocator-alloc.semanticOperation: Allocate an aligned byte window with the requested size.

extraClauses.requirement: The result is an error or a fresh aligned window with the requested size.

allocator-dupe.semanticOperation: Allocate a destination window and copy the represented source bytes into it.

extraClauses.requirement: The successful result is a fresh represented copy of the source window.

read-integer.semanticOperation: Read a fixed-width little-endian integer from the represented source window.

extraClauses.requirement: The result equals the little-endian value of the exact input bytes.

write-integer.semanticOperation: Write one fixed-width little-endian integer into the represented destination window.

extraClauses.requirement: The destination bytes equal the little-endian entry value.

transaction-decode.semanticOperation: Decode one transaction RLP item into the Zesu transaction representation.
transaction-decode.reference: deps/zesu/src/stateless/rlp_decode.zig and the pinned EVM-Sail transaction decoder

extraClauses.requirement: The accepted transaction equals the canonical EVM-Sail transaction result modulo reviewed bugs.

byte-list-list-decode.semanticOperation: Decode one SSZ variable-list offset table into represented byte slices.
byte-list-list-decode.reference: deps/zesu/src/stateless/stateless/ssz.zig and the pinned EVM-Sail SSZ decoder

extraClauses.requirement: Every result slice has the offset, length, order, and bytes required by the SSZ input.

withdrawal-decode.semanticOperation: Decode one fixed-size SSZ withdrawal record.
withdrawal-decode.reference: deps/zesu/src/stateless/stateless/ssz.zig and the pinned EVM-Sail SSZ decoder

extraClauses.requirement: The four decoded fields equal the canonical withdrawal fields.

checked-slice-selection.semanticOperation: Select one execution-request byte slice from the checked offset table.

extraClauses.requirement: The result is empty when the index exceeds the table, rejects invalid bounds, or equals the selected input slice.

fork-name.semanticOperation: Map the schema byte to the reviewed fork-name result or rejection.

extraClauses.requirement: Every accepted and rejected schema byte follows the source case split.

encoder-collection.semanticOperation: Append the canonical observation encoding of one structured collection.

extraClauses.requirement: The complete emitted substream equals the independent source encoder result.

encoder-integer.semanticOperation: Append one fixed-width integer to the observation output.

extraClauses.requirement: The emitted bytes equal the selected little-endian entry value.

encoder-optional.semanticOperation: Append the canonical tagged encoding of one optional value.

extraClauses.requirement: The tag and payload equal the entry optional value.

encoder-raw.semanticOperation: Append one represented byte window to the observation output.

extraClauses.requirement: The emitted bytes equal the complete entry byte window.
